Day 1 miles=7.3 (Saddle Lake/Tupso Pass trailhead to Goat Flats) is wrong: every source puts Goat Flats 4.5-5 mi from the trailhead (same start, the FR 41 trailhead, excluding the ~8-9 mi road walk from the Canyon Creek closure). But no two independent sources STATE the same figure: WTA Goat Flats page states '4.5 miles of hiking on true trail' after the 8-mi road walk (the WTA Three Fingers page gives 2.5 + 2 segments, same author); USFS Trail 641 gives Saddle Lake 2.5 then 2.3 more (a 4.8 sum, computed); willhiteweb gives 2.5 + 2.5; summitpost gives 2.5 + 'about 2.5'; trailchick and hike2hike give 2.5 + 2 (segments only). Summing segments is computing, so no op. The row's own approach text and its siblings r1/r2 already say Goat Flats ~4.5 mi. Owner option: set days[0].miles to 4.5 (WTA's stated figure) and the totalNote '~7.3 mi' to '~4.5 mi', or null days[0].miles as provably wrong; day 2 (7.7 mi, '~7.5 miles back out') is also inconsistent with a 4.5-5 mi Goat Flats and would need the same review.

Day 1 miles=6.2 (Foggy Dew TH to Cooney Lake) is below every source, but sources give different figures and mostly round trips/segments: WTA Cooney Lake 17.6 mi RT (4.9 on Foggy Dew Creek + 2.7 on Martin Creek + 0.2 to the lake, via Martin Creek); Wenatchee Outdoors 16.25 mi RT (5 mi to the junction, then 2.1 + 0.9 via Merchants Basin or 3 via Martin Creek); Gaia listings 7.0 and 7.9 one way; a WTA trip report 17 mi RT. No two independent sources state the same one-way figure for the same line (the row's own line goes via Merchants Basin), and halving a round trip is computing. The row's own waypoints put Cooney Lake at distMi 8. Owner option: null days[0].miles as provably low, or adopt a figure once a second source states it.

Two independent records place Denny Mountain in the Alpine Lakes Wilderness: the peak's catalog record lists 'Wilderness/Special Area: Alpine Lakes Wilderness Area' (plus Alpental ski area), and the Mountaineers route/activity pages say the trip lies within the Alpine Lakes Wilderness with self-service wilderness permits at the trailhead; Wikidata also records it as in the Alpine Lakes Wilderness. (Corroboration, not a source: the USFS wilderness boundary layer puts the summit within 50 m of the ALW boundary, i.e. on its edge; the lower pins are outside.) access.permit currently contradicts itself ('None required' then 'free self-issue day-use permit'); corrected to the wilderness permit. NOT touched: access.fees still says 'no wilderness permit needed since this route stays outside the adjacent Alpine Lakes Wilderness' - that sentence is now contradicted but access.fees is an open product decision; owner should drop that clause.

ops.expect: None required — free self-issue day-use permit at the trailhead (no quota for day use).
ops.value: Free self-issue Alpine Lakes Wilderness permit, filled out at the trailhead; required for day use as well as overnight, no quota.
